newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint ends lower vs dlr, BCE dollar futures ease.
newsitem.headline: Forint ends lower vs dlr, BCE dollar futures ease.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed weaker against the dollar on Tuesday following the U.S. unit's rise against the mark, dealers said, adding that dollar movements injected life into the market.
"The dollar's rise enlivened the market," said Gabor Butor of Unicbank.
The forint closed at 155.20/25 against the dollar compared with its opening of 154.80/83.
Despite a fairly active day, the forint remained pinned to the central bank's resistance level, dealers added.
On the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) dollar futures eased for all but one maturity, most yen maturities also finished lower, while the Swiss franc rose for all maturities.
German mark futures rose for three maturities, the sterling eased for two and the Italian lira wa mostly steady.
Ecu futures, which finished higher or steady, accounted for almost half of the total 2.06 billion forint turnover.
